title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

reports.title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

summary:
A former Costa Mesa police officer pleaded guilty to contacting his mistress thousands of times through text messages, phone calls, and social media. On at least one occasion, he contacted her more than 100 times in a single day. He also admitted to illegally accessing confidential law enforcement databases to track his wife, an ex-girlfriend, and men he considered romantic rivals.

The case involves a former member of the Costa Mesa Police Department who misused his access to sensitive police systems. His guilty plea covers both the obsessive communications and the unauthorized database searches, which invaded the privacy of several people connected to his personal life. The available information does not specify a sentencing date or the exact penalties he faces.
